C0234.title: Shared Video Account Service Ordered to Pay 2 Million Yuan in Damages
C0234.summary: A company purchased Youku VIP accounts and offered paid video streaming services through its own app, claiming it was an innovative 'shared membership' model. The court ruled that this violated the principle of good faith, harmed Youku's legitimate rights and interests, and constituted unfair competition. The final judgment ordered the company to pay approximately 2 million yuan in damages to Youk
